summary: Presents three IETF YANG modules (ietf-ssh-common, ietf-ssh-client, ietf-ssh-server) plus a script used to build four supporting IANA modules. The client and server modules support configuring and monitoring Secure Shell endpoints, and the groupings can be reused by other models that use SSH.

eli5.summary: SSH is a secret tunnel for controlling computers from far away. This gives a shared form for writing down how to set up each end of that tunnel, so many tools can fill out the same form.
